messages:
sasha (PM): Quick Q3 milestone pulse — can folks drop one-line status for their OKR items (shipped / slipped / next step). Exec wants a compact summary by EOD Fri. Focus areas: runtime perf rollout, Dedicated onboarding, Console telemetry, Optimize batching experiments. Ping owners.

jamie (Eng Lead): runtime v2 rollout — slipped. Hit a GC/latency regression under 2k+ concurrent streams during perf run. Repro steps in the ticket. Next: patch GC config + canary on staging, owner: jamie.

alex (Infra): Dedicated customer beta onboarding — mostly shipped. Network config + KMS integration done for beta tenant A. Need final infra-as-code review to flip prod capacity. Next: review PR #278 and schedule DB migration. Owner: alex. :thumbsup:

maya (Product): Console telemetry (route-level latency dashboards) — partial ship. Dashboard UI merged, but retention + sampling not wired to telemetry pipeline yet. Need one infra change (see alex) and event schema update. Next: coordinate with infra + analytics. Owner: maya.

nate (ML): Optimize batching experiments — slipped. Found degraded quality at 4k seq with current batch fusion; looking into kernel fallback. Repro + perf logs posted to the experiment thread. Next: revert batch fusion for 4k sequences and rerun A/B; owner: nate.

linda (Eng): Quick code-review pings: @jamie please review runtime PR #432 (kv-cache GC tweak). @alex can you LGTM infra PR #278 (db migration + capacity toggle)? I can pick up console wiring if infra unblock is green.

tyler (SRE): DB migration is a hard dependency for Dedicated flip — we need the migration window and rollback plan. Propose Tue 03:00 UTC maintenance window. Who owns rollout runbook?

jamie (Eng Lead): @tyler I can own the runtime rollback + canary steps. I'll draft the runbook today.

alex (Infra): I'll post the migration plan in #eng-infra and link here. Tue 03:00 UTC works if apps are warned. Will add migration rollback and feature flag toggle.

maya (Product): For Exec summary, I'll assemble a 1-pager: shipped items (Dedicated beta, Console UI), slipped items (runtime v2, batching experiments), owners and next steps. Will share draft in ~3h.

nate (ML): PR for batch revert ready, awaiting CI + review. If accepted we can rerun tests by tomorrow.

linda (Eng): pinging reviewers again. small ask: can reviewers prioritize runtime PR? It keeps multiple lanes blocked.

deploy-bot: deploy-service: staging deploy started for runtime-v2-patch (build 2026.3.14-73). Logs: https://ci.redwood/dev/2026/73

sasha (PM): Thanks — please add final owner tags to the Exec doc and mark any blockers with ETA. If anyone can't meet the Tue migration, call it out now. Otherwise I'll compile and send to Exec EOD Fri. :eyes:

jamie (Eng Lead): ETA for runtime fix + staging canary: 24-48h after PR merged. If PR merges today, we target canary tomorrow morning.

alex (Infra): LGTM on infra PR pending one small comment; will merge after response. If merged today, we can prep migration runbook and notify customer beta.

maya (Product): noted — will include the canary window in the exec 1-pager.

linda (Eng): I'll nudge reviewers in the morning at 09:00 PT.

sasha (PM): Awesome — everyone, please update your respective tracker rows and leave a one-line status in this thread when you do it.
